segments.name: Dayrate
segments.description: Ownership, contracting and operation of jack-up drilling rigs for shallow-water oil and gas exploration and production.
segments.evidence: We view our operations and manage our business as a single operating segment, our dayrate segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay dayrates for drilling contracts covering single wells, groups of wells, or stated terms on jack-up rigs.
revenueModel.evidence: We contract our jack-up rigs primarily on a dayrate basis to drill wells for our customers, including integrated oil companies, state-owned national oil companies ("NOCs") and independent oil and gas companies.
